title: GLADSTONE LAND Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Gladstone Land Corporation, an agricultural REIT listed on Nasdaq (ticker: LAND), entered into equity distribution agreements with Virtu Americas LLC and Lucid Capital Markets LLC on April 24, 2026, allowing the company to sell up to $500 million of common stock through at-the-market offerings.
key_points: Gladstone Land Corporation and its operating partnership entered into Sales Agreements with Virtu Americas LLC and Lucid Capital Markets LLC.
The company may sell shares of common stock with an aggregate offering price of up to $500.0 million.
Sales will be made through 'at the market offerings' as defined in Rule 415(a) under the Securities Act of 1933.
Each Sales Agent is entitled to compensation of up to 3.0% of the gross proceeds from shares sold.
The company has no obligation to sell any shares and may suspend solicitations at any time.
The company also filed legal opinions from Venable LLP (legality) and Squire Patton Boggs (tax matters).
